class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, capacity: float, refill_per_sec: float, clock):
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._refill_per_sec = refill_per_sec
        self._clock = clock
        self._tokens = float(capacity)
        self._last_time = self._clock()
    
    def allow(self, cost: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        now = self._clock()
        elapsed = now - self._last_time
        self._tokens = min(self._capacity, self._tokens + self._refill_per_sec * elapsed)
        self._last_time = now
        if self._tokens >= cost:
            self._tokens -= cost
            return True
        return False
    
    @property
    def tokens(self) -> float:
        now = self._clock()
        elapsed = now - self._last_time
        self._tokens = min(self._capacity, self._tokens + self._refill_per_sec * elapsed)
        self._last_time = now
        return self._tokens
